description: This Java source file defines the ScaleImage class responsible for resizing product images into multiple predefined sizes (small, medium, large, detail). It contains methods to scale images in all sizes, handling file paths, image processing, and output URL generation. The class interacts with configuration files, image transformation utilities, and ensures security checks during image writing.

external_files.name: ScaleImage
external_files.description: Java class providing image resizing functionalities; scales product images into various sizes and generates URLs.
